# 4. In-context Information
Keeping information in place, in character and out of character, in it's respective place is very important to quality roleplay.
\n
## 4.1 IC/OOC Conduct
- Information gained outside of In-Character(IC) means should not be used IC.
- Make use of proper channels: keep "BRB, taking my dog out" to the LOOC channel
- Persistent relationships and friendships are allowed, but should be cultivated IC.
- Having an IC grudge is fine, but do not let it bleed OOC. Similarly, do not allow negative OOC feelings about a player bleed into your IC conduct.
\n
## 4.2 Cloning and Revival
Ensure you are following "New-Life Rule" (NLR). Cloning and Revival may have different effects on characters in universe, you must follow these rules:
- You only recall vague details of what, or who, lead to your death. You know you were stabbed, not who stabbed you.
- You can remember the events prior to being incapacitated.
- When taking a ghost role, you know nothing about your previous characters while playing that role.
- Don't act on anything you saw while ghosted (see 2.1).
Separate to general New-Life rules, but equally important. Do not abuse the respawn system to do any of the following.
- Escape punishment by Security Forces
- Respawn on the same character after being given Permanent Confinement or Execution sentencing.
